title: Close records no payment and no receivable
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
  5. Open work order 1's log.
  6. Open customer A's Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The status reads Closed.

Step 4:

  • The Finance tab shows the document and no payment, balance or $0 payment.

Step 5:

  • The log has a Close entry where invoice created would be, and no "Invoice paid" entry.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 is not listed.
  • Customer A's balance reads $0.00: the $15.00 of shop supplies is not charged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R4: “No payment is recorded (not even the $0 payment a $0 invoice writes today) and no "Invoice paid" log entry is written, no customer transaction or receivable is created, no customer portal notification, email or invoice webhook is sent (the work order status webhook of Story 11 is), no invoice is sent to QuickBooks, the internal invoice is never listed in the Open API invoice lists and invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for it (both from the core release on, before Story 11), no tax, fee or discount is added, the shop supplies amount is not charged to the customer (it posts as an expense, Story 10), and the customer portal does not list the document (the portal vehicle list still counts a closed internal or no-charge work order for Last Service and Completed, as a service on the unit with $0.00 owed). Close and Reopen are recorded in the work order log as invoice created and reversed are today.”
  • S3-R6: “The asset Invoices tab lists the closed work order with status Closed, the badge, Total balance "No Charge" and Discount and Tax rate empty (rows on that tab have no actions). The customer's Invoices tab (the receivables ledger) does not list it; the customer's Work Orders tab does (S2-R10). GET /api/invoices/list leaves it out too (no screen uses it today). Customer statements, the customer balance and credit limit checks do not include it, and no message driven by an open balance can pick it up, since it carries none. The Finance tab menu of the closed work order offers Reopen Work Order only (S4-R1); Issue Credit is not shown, as there is nothing to credit.”
  • Goals: “A closed internal or no-charge work order creates no receivable, no payment and no customer message.”
  • Terminology: “Internal invoice → the record created by Close. It is a third invoice state, Closed, neither Invoiced nor Paid, with no customer transaction and no payment. It carries the work order number (as every invoice does today; no number is consumed or skipped), has nothing owed, and is never sent to the customer, the customer portal or an invoice webhook, nor listed in the Open API invoice lists; QuickBooks gets no invoice; AccountingHub receives it as a Closed record with no revenue (S8-R1). Its date is the posting date.”
